newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds see a few trades in afternoon.
newsitem.headline: European feeds see a few trades in afternoon.

text.p: Business on the European meals and feeds market remained slow this afternoon with only a few trades reported, market sources said.

"We saw a few nearby trades but all in all it was again a slow day despite weaker seller prices for most products. A strong dollar and pre-opening calls for a weaker Chicago soymeal futures opening kept a lid on dealings," one broker said.

Oct Brazilian soymeal pellets traded at $300 a tonne cif Rotterdam and Oct/Dec at $303. Afloat citruspulp pellets fetched $109.50 a tonne cif Rotterdam and EU rapemeal traded at 27.50 marks per 100 kg fob lower Rhine and Oct at 27.50 marks.--KAREL LUIMES +31 20 504 5832
